subject: STRING statement
notes: GR10 / Annex A.2 item 60 leave overlapping STRING operands undefined (cite.py --check 14.9.43.4 -> OK 10), A.2 -> OK 60), 4.4 2) -> OK). Owner decision 2026-10-01 (kb/Work PB1907, applied to STRING by kb/Work PB1908): document the behavior, follow GnuCOBOL 3.2 where it measurably differs, pin it. docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-STR1 to D-STR4: the statement runs in place - the image the earlier transfers built is stored into identifier-3 and a sender or an identifier delimiter that StorageOverlap.MayShareStorage cannot prove disjoint from identifier-3 is read when its transfer begins (libcob cob_string_append); the POINTER is read once at initiation and stored last (cob_string_init, cob_string_finish). A FUNCTION operand is an identifier of the statement, so 14.6.4 7) puts its range tests in statement order before identifier-3's (cite.py --check -> OK; 14.9.49.4 11) selects the declarative by that order, kb/Work PB3261): the FIRST sending (no store precedes it, GR10 cannot reach it) and any function the walk (StringEmitter.ReachOf) proves disjoint from identifier-3 are identified once, up front; a LATER sending's function that may share identifier-3's storage is identified up front too AND evaluated again, from the stored image, at its transfer, so a failing later function interrupts the statement before any character moves; only FUNCTION RANDOM (15.75.3 5) -> OK) and a shape the walk does not know (a user-defined function) stay inline and run once, at the transfer (D-STR4). Golden pb1908_string_function_order pins the order (EC-BOUND-REF-MOD before EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT). GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 was run on every golden leg and on 1,350 random STRING statements over one record (senders, delimiters and pointers as reference-modified views of the receiver): identical. The owner-signed derivation DRV-GR-14.9.43.4-10 (kb/Work PB1636, 2026-10-08) was retired: a row with a spec-derived test may not close on a derivation (design doc 1.1 refusal 1), and the PB1636 argument that any behavior conforms stays true; its sentence 'each sender at its own transfer' is now the documented behavior.
